zh-CN.controlsCopyFailed: 复制失败，请选择文本手动复制
zh-CN.controlsExistingKept: 关闭后停止新建；已有工单和附件保留，参与者仍可查看和处理。
zh-CN.controlsDisableConfirm: 要停止新建私密工单吗？已有工单仍可处理，不会删除。
zh-CN.controlsGuestExisting: 默认关闭。关闭后，原游客仍可凭有效凭证返回自己的工单。
zh-CN.controlsRestrictMember: 限制此成员在指定频道发言
zh-CN.controlsChooseChannels: 请先选择至少一个允许机器人工作的频道
zh-CN.controlsSaveRecovery: 请保存恢复码，仅本次显示
zh-CN.controlsRecoveryNote: 换设备时需要工单 ID 和恢复码。不要把恢复码发给别人。
zh-CN.controlsGuestPrivacy: 无需注册。临时名字只用于此工单，仅你、社区主和指定处理人能阅读。
zh-CN.controlsGuestClosed: 此社区暂不接受游客新工单，已有工单仍可查询。
zh-CN.controlsRecoveryOptional: 同一浏览器有有效会话时无需恢复码；换设备或会话过期时请填写。
zh-CN.controlsAccessDenied: 无法查询工单，请检查社区入口、工单 ID 和恢复码
zh-CN.controlsTicketsDisabled: 私密工单已关闭，不能新建
zh-CN.controlsGuestDisabled: 此社区暂不接受游客新工单
zh-CN.controlsRestrictionRank: 不能管理同级或更高权限成员
zh-CN.controlsChannelRestrictedError: 你在此频道被限制发言
zh-CN.controlsBotReadonly: 机器人不能在只读频道发言，请选择其他频道或仅授权读取
zh-CN.controlsRemoveReadonly: 取消频道只读（仍遵循身份组权限）

en.controlsCopyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
en.controlsExistingKept: Turning this off stops new tickets. Existing tickets and attachments remain available to their participants.
en.controlsDisableConfirm: Stop accepting new private tickets? Existing tickets remain available and can still be handled.
en.controlsGuestExisting: Off by default. Turning this off does not revoke access to existing guest tickets.
en.controlsRestrictMember: Restrict this member in selected channels
en.controlsRemoveSelected: Remove restrictions in selected channels only
en.controlsChooseChannels: Select at least one channel for this bot.
en.controlsSaveRecovery: Save your recovery code — shown only now
en.controlsRecoveryNote: You’ll need your ticket ID and recovery code on another device. Keep the code private.
en.controlsGuestPrivacy: No account needed. Your temporary name is used only in this ticket. Only you, the owner and the assigned handler can read it.
en.controlsGuestClosed: This community isn’t accepting new guest tickets. You can still find an existing ticket.
en.controlsRecoveryOptional: Leave the code blank if this browser still has an active session. Enter it on another device or after your session expires.
en.controlsFileLimit: Files must be 10 MB or smaller.
en.controlsAccessDenied: Couldn’t find an accessible ticket. Check the community link, ticket ID and recovery code.
en.controlsTicketsDisabled: New private tickets are disabled. You can still use existing tickets.
en.controlsGuestDisabled: This community isn’t accepting new guest tickets.
en.controlsRestrictionRank: You can’t restrict someone with an equal or higher role.
en.controlsChannelRestrictedError: You’re restricted from posting in this channel.
en.controlsBotReadonly: Bots can’t post in a read-only channel. Choose another channel or grant read access only.
en.controlsRemoveReadonly: Remove read-only mode (role permissions still apply)
